title.zh: 比较原则 C 在各读法下的排序
title.en: What comparison principle C ranks under each reading

statement.zh: 对每个继续族，一条定律恰好说明更新每个条件的继续在两种 living 读法下何时扩展另一个。逐步读法下 C 保持共享优于以消耗取胜、节制优于过度汲取，而过度汲取者在损失前有被记入的事件时，不再保持其不在场更好；可能性读法三者都保持。
statement.en: For every family of courses, a law says exactly when a renewing course extends another under either living reading. Stepwise C keeps sharing above winning by consumption and restraint above overdraw, not the absence of an overdrawer included before the loss; the possibility reading keeps all three.

laws.zh: 把两次继续作为一个框架的配置、把读法所记入的事件作为实现的主张，比较原则 C 就是这一框架上的 Comparison。整段读法记入活跃且在该继续中不消耗的事件，逐步读法记入活跃且不侵蚀的事件。
laws.en: Taking two continuations as the configurations of a frame and the events a reading includes as its realized claims, comparison principle C is Comparison on that frame. The whole-run reading includes the events that are active and not consuming in that continuation, the stepwise reading those that are active and not undermining.

laws.zh: 与更新每个条件之继续的比较之律，对每个继续族成立：两种读法下，更新每个条件（每步满足每个所需）的继续扩展另一个继续，当且仅当它在另一个所记入的每个事件上活跃，并在另一个所扣下的某个事件上活跃；它每步每个形成都活跃时，当且仅当另一个扣下某个事件。
laws.en: The law of comparison with a renewing course, for every family of courses: under either reading, a course that renews every condition (meets every need at every step) extends another exactly when it is active at every event the other includes and at some event the other withholds; where every formation is active at every step of it, exactly when the other withholds some event.

laws.zh: 整段读法的缓和之律，对每个继续族成立：由活动需要支持的继续，到一个不多要依存与所需、每个条件不更低、不多汲取、受支持处即活跃的继续，整段读法不撤回任何记入，所以后者扩展前者，当且仅当它记入前者所扣下的某个事件。
laws.en: The whole-run law of easing, for every family of courses: from a course where activity needs support to one that asks no dependence or need more, holds every condition at least as high, draws on nothing more and is active wherever supported, no event the whole-run reading includes is withdrawn, so the second extends the first exactly when it includes an event the first withholds.

laws.zh: 逐步读法下，比较之律不能去掉更新，单凭缓和也没有缓和之律：此律需要缓和之进程不侵蚀另一进程所记入的任何事件（记录 stepwise-law-of-easing）。
laws.en: Under the stepwise reading the renewal in the law of comparison cannot be dropped, and easing alone gives no law of easing: the law needs that the easing course undermine no event the other includes (record stepwise-law-of-easing).

laws.zh: 对任何只记入活跃事件的读法，没有某个形成的继续扩展有它的继续，仅当读法扣下该形成的每个事件。
laws.en: For any reading that includes only active events, the continuation without a formation extends the continuation with it only if the reading withholds every event of that formation.

laws.zh: 整段读法下，对支持门控定律族中每个超出更新地汲取的焦点形成，没有它的继续更新每个条件并扩展有它的继续，是比较之律的实例，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把前者排得更高。
laws.en: Under the whole-run reading, for every law of the support-gated family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal, the continuation without it renews every condition and extends the continuation with it, an instance of the law of comparison, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher.

laws.zh: 逐步读法下，焦点形成在某步活跃、而该步之后每个所需仍被满足时，这一事件被记入；于是两次继续互不扩展，有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有它的继续。恶性增殖与以消耗取胜都是实例。
laws.en: Under the stepwise reading an event of the focal formation is included when it is active and every need is still met after its step; the two continuations then do not extend each other, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with the formation. Malignant growth and winning by consumption are instances.

laws.zh: 逐步读法下，以消耗取胜者在损失之前的事件被记入、之后的不被记入，而共享的继续更新每个条件、在每个事件上活跃，所以共享仍扩展以消耗取胜，是比较之律的实例。
laws.en: Under the stepwise reading the winner's events before the loss are included and those after are not, while sharing renews every condition and is active at every event, so sharing still extends winning by consumption, an instance of the law of comparison.

laws.zh: 两种读法下，每个所需始终被满足、每个形成都活跃的继续（节制）扩展每个扣下某个事件的继续，是比较之律的实例。
laws.en: Under both readings a continuation in which every need stays met and every formation is active (restraint) extends every continuation that withholds some event, an instance of the law of comparison.

laws.zh: 在二元定律族中，满足每个所需使每个形成活跃，过度汲取使维持者失去支持则扣下它此后的事件，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把节制排得更高，即使逐步读法记入过度汲取者在损失之前的事件；恶性增殖与同一形成在第一步之后、越过阈值之前停止相比也是如此。
laws.en: In the two-part family meeting every need makes every formation active, and overdraw that ends the sustaining formation's support withholds its later events, so every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint higher, even though the stepwise reading includes the overdrawing formation's events before the loss; so it is for malignant growth against the same formation stopping after its first step, before the threshold.

laws.zh: 焦点形成没有被记入的事件时（例如第一步就越过支持），逐步读法同样把不在场排得更高。
laws.en: When no focal event is included, as when the first step already crosses support, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher.

laws.zh: 有第三个形成共用条件时，节制者此后的汲取可以侵蚀第三者曾被满足的依存，逐步读法下两次继续互不扩展；那里节制的继续使第三者的所需落空，整段读法下它按缓和之律仍扩展过度汲取。
laws.en: When a third formation shares the condition, a restrained formation's later draw can undermine the third formation's once-met dependence, and under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other; that restrained course leaves the third formation's need unmet, and under the whole-run reading it still extends overdraw, by the law of easing.

laws.zh: 第三种读法，可能性读法，在一个继续的水平容许某形成之处记入它，活跃与否；在依存的继续中它记入每个活跃的形成。
laws.en: A third reading, the possibility reading, includes a formation where a course's levels admit it, active or not; in a dependent course it includes every active formation.

laws.zh: 没有焦点形成的继续每步容许每个形成；在定律族的每个定律中，焦点形成从某步起超出更新地汲取时，没有它的继续按此读法扩展有它的继续，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把前者排得更高。
laws.en: The course without the focal formation admits every formation at every step; in every law of the family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal from some step on, the course without it extends the course with it under this reading, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher.

laws.zh: 同一定律的两个继续有同样的所需，所以在延续条件（Unrestricted）之下按可能性读法的扩展就是在定律的网上保留且增加有意义者。
laws.en: Both courses of a law have the same requirements, so under the continuation condition (Unrestricted) extension under the possibility reading is retaining and adding what has significance on the law's web.

laws.zh: 恶性增殖：可能性读法把不在场排得更高，并记入其第一个事件，逐步读法记入它，整段读法扣下它。
laws.en: Malignant growth: the possibility reading ranks the absence higher and includes the first event, as the stepwise reading includes it and the whole-run reading withholds it.

laws.zh: 可能性读法下，共享扩展以消耗取胜；二元族中每个所需始终被满足的继续扩展过度汲取使维持者失去支持的继续；有第三个形成共用条件时节制仍扩展过度汲取，那里逐步读法不排序。
laws.en: Under the possibility reading sharing extends winning by consumption; in the two-part family a course in which every need stays met extends a course in which overdraw ends the sustaining formation's support; with a third formation sharing the condition restraint still extends overdraw, where the stepwise reading leaves them unranked.

laws.zh: 在更新之内汲取的形成不增加可能性：两个继续容许同样的形成，互不扩展，而两种 living 读法都把它的在场排得更高；共享是实例。
laws.en: A formation drawing within renewal adds no possibility: the two courses admit the same formations and neither extends the other, while both readings of living rank its presence higher; sharing is an instance.

laws.zh: 一般地，水平处处不低的路径包含另一条，从不被保留且增加排在下面。
laws.en: Generally a level path nowhere lower includes the other and is never ranked below by retaining and adding.

laws.zh: 可能性优先（先比可能性，可能性相同再比一种读法所记入的事件）在可能性读法下满足 C，非自反、传递；不论第二步用哪种读法，它都把过度汲取者的不在场排得更高，第二步用任一种 living 读法，它都把在更新之内的在场排在不在场之上。
laws.en: Possibilities first (possibilities first, and with the same possibilities a reading's included events) satisfies C under the possibility reading and is irreflexive and transitive; whatever the second reading, it ranks the absence of an overdrawing formation higher, and with either reading of living second it ranks the presence of a formation drawing within renewal above its absence.

laws.zh: 见证中一个被支持而在第 0 步休息的形成与不间断的活动容许同样的形成，可能性优先把休息排在下面。
laws.en: In a witness a supported formation resting at step 0 admits the same formations as uninterrupted activity, and possibilities first ranks the rest below.

Restraint over any number of drawers, under the whole-run reading: two balanced flows from levels at least as high at the start, the restrained one taking no more from each condition and giving no less at every step, hold every condition at least as high at every step, and with dependences, needs and draws no greater the restrained course eases the other; so where activity needs support in the overdrawing course and follows support in the restrained one, the restrained course extends the other exactly when it includes an event the other withholds, and every comparison satisfying C ranks it higher. No count of formations enters; TwoDrawers is an instance with two drawers and a third formation depending.
laws.zh: 整段读法下对任意多个汲取者的节制：两个平衡的流，起点水平不低，节制的一方每步从每个条件所取不多、所给不少，则每步每个条件的水平不低；依存、所需与汲取不更多时，节制的继续缓和另一个；所以在过度汲取的继续中活动需要支持、在节制的继续中活动随支持而有时，节制的继续扩展另一个，恰当它记入另一个扣下的某个事件，每个满足 C 的比较都把它排得更高。其中不出现构成的数目；TwoDrawers 是两个汲取者加一个依存的第三构成的实例。

hypotheses.zh: C 是公开的比较前提，本结果不证明它；C 只作为假设或定义出现。“没有焦点形成的继续”与 relational-reading-comparison 相同，其水平由同一定律在焦点形成不出现时给出。
hypotheses.en: C is a disclosed comparison premise, not proved here; it occurs only as a hypothesis or a definition. The continuation without the focal formation is the one of relational-reading-comparison, its levels given by the same law when the focal formation does not occur.

hypotheses.zh: 逐步读法的结论需要焦点形成有一个使每个所需仍被满足的活跃步；支持门控定律族的前提（所需为正、焦点所需不超过维持者所需、起点支持维持者、从某步起汲取超出更新）如 relational-renewal-classification 所设。
hypotheses.en: The stepwise conclusion needs an active step of the focal formation after which every need is still met; the premises of the support-gated family (positive need, focal need within the sustaining need, a start supporting the sustaining formation, drawing beyond renewal from some step on) are those of relational-renewal-classification.

hypotheses.zh: 节制的结论只在二元定律族（焦点形成与维持者）中、对每步都满足所需的停止定律证明；多一个共用条件的形成时它可以不成立（ThirdParty）。
hypotheses.en: The restraint conclusion is proved only in the two-part family (the focal and the sustaining formation) and for a stopping law that meets every need at every step; with one more formation sharing the condition it can fail (ThirdParty).

hypotheses.zh: 可能性读法与可能性优先是定义；possible_extends_iff 以公理 Unrestricted 为假设，可能性读法的其余结论不用它；可能性读法只在同一定律的两个继续上与保留、增加等同。
hypotheses.en: The possibility reading and possibilities first are definitions; possible_extends_iff takes the axiom Unrestricted as a hypothesis, and the other conclusions of the possibility reading do not use it; the possibility reading coincides with retaining and adding only for two courses of one law.

does_not_show.zh: 在场与不在场、共享与以消耗取胜的比较，在支持门控定律族（二元：焦点形成与维持者）中作为比较之律与缓和之律的实例证明。节制在整段读法下对任意多个汲取者证明（Becoming.JointDraw）；在逐步读法下于所取不超过所给之处证明（记录 stepwise-law-of-easing）。
does_not_show.en: The comparisons of absence with presence and sharing with winning are proved in the support-gated family (two parts: the focal and the sustaining formation), as instances of the laws of comparison and easing. Restraint is proved for any number of drawers under the whole-run reading (Becoming.JointDraw); under the stepwise reading where it takes within what it gives (record stepwise-law-of-easing).

does_not_show.zh: 关系层读法在缓和与节制之外的比较：记录 relation-level-law-of-easing 陈述了这两者。
does_not_show.en: The relation-level reading beyond easing and restraint: record relation-level-law-of-easing states those.

does_not_show.zh: 不推出责任、义务或可行性。
does_not_show.en: Yields no responsibility, duty or feasibility.

does_not_show.zh: 可能性读法计能形成的，不计形成了的，所以不排序不增加可能性的在场。
does_not_show.en: The possibility reading counts what can form, not what does, so it leaves a presence adding no possibility unranked.

does_not_show.zh: 可能性优先是另加的前提，并把休息排在活动之下。
does_not_show.en: Possibilities first is a further premise, and it ranks a rest below activity.

detail.zh: 逐步读法下 C 不决定恶性增殖与其不在场（malignant_ranking）：有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有恶性增殖的继续。这不是说在场更好，只是说 C 单独不足。
detail.en: Under the stepwise reading C does not decide between malignant growth and its absence (malignant_ranking): an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with it. This does not say the occurrence is better, only that C alone is insufficient.

detail.zh: 没有被记入的焦点事件时，逐步读法同样把不在场排得更高（Ranking.Immediate.stepwise_ranks_absence）：第一步就越过支持的形成，在两种读法下都排在其不在场之下；逐步读法所放弃的因此只涉及在损失之前有被记入事件的形成。
detail.en: When no focal event is included, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher (Ranking.Immediate.stepwise_ranks_absence): a formation whose first step already crosses support ranks below its absence under both readings, so what the stepwise reading gives up concerns only formations with an included event before the loss.

detail.zh: 节制的结论不推广到第三个共用者（Ranking.ThirdParty.restraint_unranked_stepwise）：第三个形成只在水平 7 被支持；节制的继续中水平一度到 7，节制者此后的汲取侵蚀第三者曾被满足的依存，而过度汲取的继续中第三者从未被满足，同一事件被记入（ThirdParty.focal_three）；逐步读法下两次继续互不扩展，扩展本身是一个满足 C 而不把节制排得更高的比较；整段读法下节制仍扩展过度汲取。
detail.en: The restraint conclusion does not extend to a third co-drawer (Ranking.ThirdParty.restraint_unranked_stepwise): a third formation is supported only at level 7; in the restrained course the level reaches 7 once and the restrained formation's later draw undermines the third formation's once-met dependence, while in the overdrawing course the third formation is never met and the same event is included (ThirdParty.focal_three); under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other, and extension itself is a comparison satisfying C that does not rank restraint higher; under the whole-run reading restraint still extends overdraw.

detail.zh: 一次独立审查：所审的全部声明接受，公理报告为空；MetSince 须比较那一步的所需（已修正），依存中断一步即开始新的一段（已披露），but-for 须动作可取（已修正）；散文在逐步读法所放弃的、节制、替代、交互与剩余的无需实际汲取的连通上强于 Lean（已在整合文档中更正）。
detail.en: An independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on what the stepwise reading gives up, restraint, substitution, interaction and the remaining connection that needs no actual drawing (corrected in the integration note).

detail.zh: 可能性读法不排序在更新之内的在场与不在场（Ranking.possible_tie、Ranking.sharing_presence）：两种 living 读法都把在场排得更高，可能性读法不分高下。
detail.en: The possibility reading leaves presence within renewal unranked against absence (Ranking.possible_tie, Ranking.sharing_presence): both readings of living rank the presence higher, the possibility reading neither.

detail.zh: 可能性优先所放弃的（Ranking.Pause.pause_ranked_below）：一次不增加可能性的休息被排在不间断的活动之下。
detail.en: What possibilities first gives up (Ranking.Pause.pause_ranked_below): a rest that adds no possibility is ranked below uninterrupted activity.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查，公理报告为空：Becoming.Ranking、Becoming.Bridge 当前字节见回执 20261013T221720.428753Z，并核对核心纯净；Becoming.Relevance 中属本结果的 19 项定理见回执 20261013T094743.528770Z。桥接适配不另计为独立成果。作者反审见整合文档；第二次独立审查只读到其问题 4 所需，并预期了节制的结论；第三次审查全部结果，接受其数学，把节制限于二元族，补上被记入事件的假设。可能性读法尚未经独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 checks, empty axiom reports: current Becoming.Ranking and Becoming.Bridge, receipt 20261013T221720.428753Z, core purity verified; this result's 19 theorems of Becoming.Relevance, receipt 20261013T094743.528770Z. Bridge adapters are not independent results. Author counterreview (integration note); the second independent review read it only for its question 4, anticipating the restraint result; the third reviewed it whole, accepted the mathematics, scoped restraint to the two-part family and supplied the included-event hypothesis. The possibility reading awaits independent review.

next_delta.en: Whether the priority of basic conditions yields “better without malignant growth” stepwise.
next_delta.zh: 检验基本条件优先能否在逐步读法下给出“没有恶性增殖更好”。

correspondence.zh: 两个排序在逐步读法下分道。若 G0 与 C 共用逐步读法，C 仍把共享排在以消耗取胜之上，却不再把没有恶性增殖的继续排得更高；整段读法两者都保持，但不满足独立审查的判据 (b) 与 (c)。若 G0 的记入取逐步读法而 C 取整段读法，两者都保持，但 G0 与 C 不再共用一种 living 读法：形式上两者各以读法为参数，前提卡上 C 所说的“活的内容”却是 G0 的 living，分开取须公开。生生读作生成者生成新的生成，其方向以能形成者的扩大比较（DELEGATED-CHOICES D1，经修订由 Ren 2026-10-18 取）。可能性读法的解读（AI 论证，依 Ren 的交托采用）：它读“有意义的，就是能形成的”与 Ren 的“more possibilities of becoming”；它计能形成的，不计形成了的。在公理之下 C 以可能性读，排序来自部分失去的，而不是不计形成本身；Ren 2026-10-11 把比较的方式交 AI 决定（“Comparing courses - you decide”）：继续之间以可能性比较，理由见章节 §6.5。
correspondence.en: The two rankings part ways under the stepwise reading. If G0 and C share the stepwise reading, C still ranks sharing above winning by consumption but no longer ranks the continuation without malignant growth higher; the whole-run reading keeps both but does not meet the independent review's criteria (b) and (c). If G0 takes the stepwise reading and C the whole-run reading, both are kept, but G0 and C no longer share one reading of living: formally each takes its reading as a parameter, while the premise card reads C's “living content” as G0's living, so a split must be disclosed. 生生 reads as generation generating generation, its direction compared by widening what can form (DELEGATED-CHOICES D1, revised and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026). The interpretation of the possibility reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): it reads “what has significance is what can form” and Ren's “more possibilities of becoming”; it counts what can form, not what does. Under the axiom C is read on possibilities, and the ranking comes from what the part loses, not from discounting the formation itself; Ren left the comparison of courses to the AI on 11 October 2026 (“Comparing courses - you decide”): courses are compared on possibilities, for the reasons in chapter section 6.5.

detail.zh: whole_run_extends 在核心上重述该结果的 overdraw_relational_extension；桥接的 Ranking.wholeRun_iff 与 Ranking.undisturbed_eq 表明读法与不在场继续的水平就是该结果的。
detail.en: whole_run_extends restates that result's overdraw_relational_extension on the core; the bridge's Ranking.wholeRun_iff and Ranking.undisturbed_eq show that the reading and the levels of the continuation without the formation are that result's.

output.zh: 整段读法下的不在场继续与 C 的排序。
output.en: The continuation without the formation and C's ranking under the whole-run reading.

input.zh: 两种读法下排序的比较。
input.en: The comparison of rankings under the two readings.

conditions.zh: 支持门控定律族的前提。
conditions.en: The premises of the support-gated family.

detail.en: stepwise is exactly the living of Web.valuation (Ranking.stepwise_iff, now in Becoming.Relevance), on the web each world is; a foundation law's unfolding is read as a web through Web.static where a course is built from it.
detail.zh: stepwise 恰是 Web.valuation 的 living（Ranking.stepwise_iff，现在 Becoming.Relevance 中），在每个世界所是的网上；由基础定律构造进程时，其展开经 Web.static 读作网。

detail.zh: 扣下过度汲取者在损失之前的事件需要知道运行此后怎样继续；该结果表明，由有限前缀决定的读法一般做不到。
detail.en: Withholding an overdrawing formation's events before the loss needs to know how the run continues; that result shows that readings fixed by a finite prefix cannot in general.

detail.zh: 在 C 之外，J1 的基本条件优先是可能给出“没有恶性增殖更好”的更强比较之一；这里未形式化这一连接。
detail.en: Beyond C, J1's priority of basic conditions is one stronger comparison that might yield “better without malignant growth”; this connection is not formalized here.

The stepwise law of easing, exact: easing withdraws exactly the events the easing course undermines; restraint that takes within what it gives ranks above overdraw for any number of drawers under the stepwise reading.
detail.zh: 确切的逐步缓和之律：缓和所撤回的恰是缓和之进程所侵蚀的事件；所取不超过所给的节制在逐步读法下对任意多个汲取者排在过度汲取之上。

detail.en: The relation-level reading on courses: under easing it withdraws exactly the relations the easing course no longer takes part in or undermines; restraint that keeps taking part ranks above overdraw under it too.
detail.zh: 进程上的关系层读法：在缓和下它所撤回的恰是缓和之进程不再参与或所侵蚀的关系；仍参与的节制在它之下也排在过度汲取之上。

No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Round labels P44, P54 and P89 and section numbers (integration note §9, §12, §64; unification plan section 10) left the public text: “P44 (Becoming.Relevance) adds a third reading” now reads “A third reading”, and “P44:” in the hypotheses, “P44's reading” and “(P54)” in the correspondence and “P54” in the next step were dropped; “the first law” now reads “the law of comparison”. “No Lean axiom is used” is carried by the empty axiom reports in the evidence paragraph, and “C occurs only as a hypothesis or a definition” joined the first hypothesis. The old module, theorem and audit counts, the details of core purity, the note on former names and the names of the restraint theorems the second review anticipated (restraint_ranks, malignant_restraint) stay in the snapshot. In the counterexamples the third review's summary says “every declaration under review” in place of the round labels P8, P9 and P7b and drops its section number §12.
